	chain prerouting {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		ip version 4 counter name "cnt_ipv4"
		ip6 version 6 counter name "cnt_ipv6"
		ct state invalid counter name "cnt_invalid" drop
		ct state { established, related } counter name "cnt_accepted" accept
		icmp type { echo-reply, destination-unreachable, echo-request, time-exceeded } counter name "cnt_icmp" accept
		icmpv6 type { destination-unreachable, packet-too-big, time-exceeded, echo-request, echo-reply, nd-router-advert, nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert } counter name "cnt_icmp" accept
		iifname "lo" accept
		iifname "dtn1.912" jump jump_dtn1
		iifname "dtn1.916" jump jump_dtn1
		ip saddr 198.128.14.247 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:14:f::1f accept
		ip saddr 198.128.155.64 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:210:155::40 accept
		ip saddr 198.124.250.199 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:6441::107 accept
		ip saddr 198.129.250.209 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:211::10a accept
		ip saddr 198.128.128.99 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:211:11::3 accept
		ip saddr 198.128.128.100 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:211:11::4 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:c003:5::/64 tcp dport 50051 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:c203:5::/64 tcp dport 50051 accept
		ip saddr 198.128.155.8 tcp dport 1-1024 drop
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:210:155::8 tcp dport 1-1024 drop
		ip saddr 198.128.155.8 udp dport 1-1024 drop
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:210:155::8 udp dport 1-1024 drop
		ip saddr 198.128.155.8 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:210:155::8 accept
		ip saddr @gateways_v4 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 saddr @gateways_v6 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip saddr @ansible_v4 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 saddr @ansible_v6 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip saddr 198.129.250.226 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:211:82::6 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip saddr @moka_v4 udp dport 161 accept
		ip6 saddr @moka_v6 udp dport 161 accept
		ip saddr @moka_v4 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 saddr @moka_v6 tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:210:159::8a tcp dport 9001 accept
		ip saddr 198.128.159.138 tcp dport 9001 accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:400:210:159::8a tcp dport 5050 accept
		ip saddr 198.128.159.138 tcp dport 5050 accept
		drop
	}

	chain output {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
		ct state invalid counter name "cnt_invalid" drop
		ct state { established, related } counter name "cnt_accepted" accept
		icmp type { echo-reply, destination-unreachable, echo-request, time-exceeded } counter name "cnt_icmp" accept
		icmpv6 type { destination-unreachable, packet-too-big, time-exceeded, echo-request, echo-reply, nd-router-advert, nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert } counter name "cnt_icmp" accept
		iifname "dtn1.912" jump jump_dtn1-out
		iifname "dtn1.916" jump jump_dtn1-out
		accept
		drop
	}

	chain jump_dtn1-out {
		ip saddr @dtnExternal_v4 accept
		ip6 saddr @dtnExternal_v6 accept
		tcp dport 443 accept
